name: Paneer Lababdar Light
ingredients: 120 g low-fat paneer, half grated and half cubed
½ tsp each cumin and coriander powder
1 tsp kasuri methi and ½ tsp garam masala
steps: Heat the oil, crackle the cumin, and cook onion, garlic, ginger and chilli for 6 minutes.
Add the tomato purée and spices and cook for 8 minutes until thick.
Add the capsicum and ½ cup water and simmer for 4 minutes.
Stir in the grated paneer and silken tofu to thicken the gravy.
Add the paneer cubes, kasuri methi and garam masala; simmer for 3 minutes.
note: Grated paneer thickens the gravy so no cream is needed.
